tagline: The AI lesson ladder: full lessons and their practice drills, in order, in one place.

guides.title: The Lesson Ladder
guides.body: Lessons are numbered and build in order. Lesson 1 is Prompting Basics That Actually Work. Lesson 2 is Emails and Messages That Sound Like You. Work them in order: each lesson assumes the one before it, and the channel specials sit on top of the ladder once you have the basics.

guides.title: Drills Are The Point
guides.body: The Shorts are practice drills, not extras: the 60-Second Prompt Drill belongs to Lesson 1, the Voice Match Drill to Lesson 2. Do a lesson's drill right after the lesson, while it is fresh, then move up the ladder.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
